sourceChecks.text: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.
